The global minimum -18/5 occurs at axes; diagonal-restriction eigenvalues s±sqrt(s²−3r) yield Q±=18s−18/5±12sqrt(s²−3r). A Schur inequality shows Q+≤39/10 with equality exactly at two-equal-nonzero squared-coordinate normals. Thus I+epsilon Q is semidefinite iff epsilon∈[-10/39,5/18].
